entities.summary: Wallace Leandro de Souza, known by the mononym Wallace, is a Brazilian volleyball player, member of the Brazil men's national volleyball team, 2016 Olympic Champion, silver medallist of the Olympic Games, 2014 and 2018 World Championship, three–time South American Champion.
